problem: The existing emergence outcome file is anchored to a single 13:05 ET source snapshot, so later intraday emerging signals are not accumulated into one point-in-time learning ledger.
The mandatory Top-20 end-of-session Predicted Early / Detected Late / Missed / Data-Unverified audit was not yet a dedicated fail-closed artifact tied to reconciled final outcomes.

evidenceBefore.learningRisk: single-snapshot sampling can hide later signals and distort persistence/false-positive estimates

implemented.behavior: Every distinct fresh live snapshot (<=12 minutes) appends immutable point-in-time observations per ticker; stale snapshots are rejected; no retroactive signal creation.

After strict two-source final reconciliation, rank top 20 reconciled movers and classify each as Predicted Early, Detected Late, Missed, or Data-Unverified from point-in-time ledgers; persist 5/20-session adjusted-rate trends.

championChallenger.reason: This cycle improves measurement coverage and replay truth; it does not yet provide multi-session evidence for changing production ranking thresholds.

nextMeasurement: Compare session-level Top-20 early-capture and false-positive cohorts after the strict 20:00 ET final candidate/reconciliation is available; promote no threshold from one session.
